facts.fact: A workshop on 10-11 November 2021, opened by the chief of staff of the Ministry of Digital Economy, Posts and Telecommunications, presented the studies for the Plan National Stratégique Centrafrique Digitale 2025; no adoption is stated.
The document gives the plan's period as 2020-2025.

systems.country_label: Plan National Stratégique Centrafrique Digitale 2020-2025 (PNS CD 2025)
systems.owner: Ministère de l'Economie Numérique, des Postes et Télécommunications
République centrafricaine; financed by the European Union and the African Development Bank
Ministère de l'Economie Numérique, des Postes et Télécommunications

note: Class is empty: the document describes the plan only as built on orientations to develop electronic communications through wider connectivity, which does not settle whether it is national or sector-ict. The studies were commissioned under the CAB-RCA project.
